films.title: RISE

films.title: Made In Chicago
films.description: Sapient Skateboards' first full-length spent nearly three years documenting Chicago and its surrounding scene without leaving the region. The 33.8-minute film celebrates the do-it-yourself culture behind the city's spots, board making and indoor spaces through 14 first-party featured skaters plus one independently indexed appearance.
creditNotes: Sapient's official upload supplies 14 featured skaters; Ty Santor's editing credit; Ty Santor, Miguel Huerta and Harry Reynolds as principal filmers; 10 additional filmers; and supported introduction and photography credits.
SkateVideoSite independently classifies Made In Chicago as a 34-minute 2026 full-length, indexes 15 skaters and identifies Ty Santor, Miguel Huerta and Will Stephan in its film header.
Official spellings are retained where the independent index differs: Gerardo Mendoza, Andrea Paar and Tim Nelson. Jesus Paz is kept separately as an independently indexed appearance.
films.locationNote: Sapient states that every clip was filmed in Chicago and the greater surrounding area. SkateVideoSite additionally identifies Irish Banks and Seawall; no locations outside the region are asserted.
films.historicalContext: Made In Chicago is Sapient Skateboards' first full-length and a deliberate portrait of the city's DIY ethos: building spots, pressing boards locally and sustaining indoor spaces through harsh winters.
films.artworkNotes: The exact official upload's 1280x720 YouTube max-resolution thumbnail was visually reviewed on 2026-09-16. It shows SAPiENT painted on a freight car against the Chicago skyline, with no trailer or episode labeling.
